versions.changelog:
- Enhanced documentation for full lifecycle management of CloudRobo data processing (proc-tasks) and data evaluation (eval-tasks), including algorithm discovery, batch/bulk task management, and troubleshooting workflows.
- Detailed step-by-step interactive task creation and orchestration workflows, including pipelines and batch processing scenarios.
- Added explicit examples and standards for CLI command formats and option usage.
- Provided comprehensive troubleshooting, diagnosis, and analytics best practices for error resolution and failure analysis.
- Improved clarity and thoroughness in workflow sections, core command references, and architectural overview.
